description:
We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape patient care, foster a positive work environment, and ensure the highest standards of clinical excellence. Join a team committed to providing compassionate and high-quality care to residents.
As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of nursing services. This includes managing nursing staff, developing and implementing care policies, ensuring regulatory compliance, and overseeing patient care plans. We are looking for a leader who can inspire and mentor staff while maintaining exceptional clinical outcomes. This role offers a competitive annual salary.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing leadership experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
Ability to develop and implement effective patient care programs
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
